title: JIR-Arena: The First Benchmark Dataset for Just-in-time Information Recommendation
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for Just-in-time Information Recommendation (JIR) systems, specifically evaluating their ability to predict and resolve information needs in academic and conference settings. The evaluation metrics (precision, recall, timeliness, and relevance) and the dataset contents (lectures/talks) do not involve religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical benchmarking.
